description:
What is This Part?
This is a Suzuki Samurai Parts Catalog that encompasses parts for all years of the Samurai including the years after the fuel system was changed to EFI.
What Will I Receive?
This will be sent to your Email account in the form of a PDF file.
It can also be printed and mailed to you.
There is an additional charge of $8 for this delivery method.
It can be paid via an invoice that will be send to your PayPal Account.
Condition: NEW
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai
1985 – 1995 with 4 Cylinder, 1.3L, 8 Valve – Engine
All models
